question: Should exec/process/node-host tool results redact secret-shaped output by default, accepting non-byte-exact returned output, or should this PR add an explicit raw-output reveal path before merge?
rationale: The code repair is narrow and covered, but the default behavior changes the agent-visible security and compatibility contract for command output, which automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept default redaction
options.body: Merge this PR as the default safety boundary and open a narrower follow-up only if raw-output reveal proves necessary.

options.title: Require reveal path first
options.body: Ask the contributor to add an explicit opt-in raw-output reveal control and tests before this security fix lands.

options.title: Pause or reject direction
options.body: Keep the PR paused or close it if maintainers decide exec/process output must remain byte-exact by default.

recommendation.title: Accept default redaction
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the default safety boundary and open a narrower follow-up only if raw-output reveal proves necessary.
